ContentLayoutDraft.title: Content layout draft
ContentLayoutDraft.description: A named pointer into the revision graph of a stored layout.

base.description: Id of the revision the draft was opened from: the live revision, or `fromRevisionId` for a rollback.

head.description: Id of the latest revision saved on the draft; the `expectedHead` of the next draft mutation and of `publish-draft`.

createdById.description: Id of the admin user who created the draft, `null` when an integration or the system created it.

ContentLayoutPublishedRevision.title: Content layout published revision
ContentLayoutPublishedRevision.description: A revision of a stored layout that has been live; a draft opened from it rolls the layout back.

id.description: Id of the revision; the `fromRevisionId` of `create-draft`.

live.description: Whether the live pointer is on this revision. A layout write that bypassed publishing moves the pointer only when the next draft write adopts it.

createdById.description: Id of the admin user who saved the revision, `null` when an integration, the system or a layout write that bypassed publishing created it.

publishedAt.description: The first time the revision went live.

publishedById.description: Id of the admin user who first published the revision, `null` when an integration, the system or a layout write that bypassed publishing did.

lastLiveAt.description: The latest time the revision went live, later than `publishedAt` after a rollback to it.

ContentLayoutPersistedMutationResponse.title: Content layout persisted mutation response
ContentLayoutPersistedMutationResponse.description: The mutation response of a persisted mutation route. A draft mutation also returns the draft it moved.

draft.description: Present only for a draft mutation (`draftId` in the body). Its `head` is the revision the mutation appended.
